## Chapter Three

JailHouse Rock







Lucas found himself standing in line later that morning in a long concrete hall, in a line of older shisheveled men, slowly making there way to some entrance. The sign on the wall stated “Richmond Federal Detention Facility” in large black letters painted against the grey concrete. Lucas moved with the line, like a great slow snake they inched forward towards the rectangle of light, guards stood every hundred feet staring intently. Lucas watched as a few men forward of him, someone stumbled and fell the guards were on him quickly, berating and beating the poor man, as the person behind him reached down to help the poor guy up, he too was beaten, until both were moving again, the guards loosing interest and moving back to there posts, but Lucas had seen the mad glee in there eyes, they enjoyed the pain, he would need to be carefull, these men, these guards would only need an excuse to end his life. He was shaking, scared and exposed in only his underwear as they moved.



He had never understood what it felt like to be alone and in a hostile environment, all his life had been spent around people and institutions that looked out for his well being, but this eh thought, this is what life was like, you were alone, enemies surrounded you on all sides not only those who looked like they would hurt you, the down trodden and shisheveled criminals, but also those who wore uniforms of protection, those who’s jobs it was to keep people safe could also be the enemy, Lucas felt he had stumbled onto an importan lesson, but he was too scared and too tired to follow the train of thought, instead he just moved forward and kept his eyes down as the line slowly ambled towards the door.



Reaching the door he turned to the smalled barred window to the old man who stood there, his sour expression studying some screen as he peered at Lucas and hten down at his screen. “You are prisoner 811432, this is your number, never forget it “ he said “It will be printed on ever piece of clothing you own, it will be how you eat, move and exist, you no longer have a name, do you understand” the old man asked , Lucas nodded  eyeing the guard next to him. The young guard smiled maliciously and stepped towards him “What is you name?” he asked Lucas casually “My.. My name is Lu” be began but his head exploded with pain as the guards baton made contact with his skull, again and again as Lucas collapsed to the floor “You have no name, you do not exist, you are only a number, do you understand” the guard screamed at him leaning down close to his ear, close enough where every word hurt as the guard screamed it. Lucas curled into a fetal position, crying he quickly nodded, anything to stop this man from hurting him. The guard spat on his back and made a disgusted noise, kicking him hard in the stomach he leaned down again “Now off with you, and pick up your clothes” he said kicking Lucas a second time, his fetal position protecting most of his sensitive parts. It took him a moment to stand unsteadily and the guard approached as if to hit Lucas again, this made him speed up, he grabbed his clothes and nearly sprinted through the door.



Lucas made his way down the dark hall, lined with doors for as far as the eye could see, they marched the group into a large room about half the size of the school gymnasium and then forced them to line up along the wall, first putting the pile of bedding and clothes on a stool about fifteen feet in front of each person. “Now Strip” the lead guard called as everyone began to take off the last piece of dignity they had and then a guard came down the line collecting the underwear in a garbage bag, Lucas stood there naked and covering his manhood doing his best to stare at the floor giving into his insecurities.



Before he could prepare himself a jet of cold water assaulted his body, pushing him back against the stone wall, for a moment he couldn’t breath as he opened his mouth to scream and the jet filled every crevice around his tongue and forced its way down his throat. Lucas bent over, throwing up water for a good five minutes before he regained control of himself. “Now put on the only clothes you will wear for your time here” announced the guard and the line of men walked over, dripping wet to there piles and began to put on the clothes, transferring the water from there bodies to the fabric, everyone of them looking like a dround rat. Ten minutes later Lucas stood in the middle of a twelve by twelve room adourned with a sink/toilet and a bunk bed as the doors slammed closed on him. He suddently realized this would be his home for the next decade and tears began to stream down his face, as he cried for his life, cried for his father and mostly just cried for the unfairness of it all.



He did that for ten minutes and then dried his face, it was at that moment he knew he had a choice to make, this place could end him, he could become the animal that they said he was , or he could fight, fight to keep his humanity , fight to keep his sense of self. Lucas Christian sat on the edge of his bunk and recited his name, over and over, he would not forget who he was, he would not forget what they had done to him.



He awoke with a start the next morning to the unfamiliar sounds of the prison as the day began. A loud klaxon rang at five thirty stirring those still asleep. “Up and adam convicts, breakfast in thirty” came the booming voice of a guard over the loud speaker. Lucas sat up disoriented, hoping the last two days had been a nightmare, but as he opened his eyes, the reality of the situation settled on his mind along with a deep core rattling depression. This was now his reality, his life he thought as another tear escaped his eye. “No tears boy, they are a sign of weakness in here, and you do not want to show weakness” came a voice from the bars. Lucas looked and spotted an older man with salt and pepper features and a three-day beard, he handed in new linens through the hole in the door and Lucas’s eyes locked on the ice blue orbs that looked at him through the dirty window. He didn’t speak, just watched the older man, he looked capable and hard, So Lucas wiped the tear away with a nod and tried to match the mans hard gaze, but he couldn’t hold it, his life was over and his fire for resistance was burning out, he dropped his gaze, slowly walking over and grabbing the linens, but the older man didn’t let go. “Do not show weakness boy, and you need to watch your back, always” said the man severely then let go of the linens almost causing Lucas to fall. “Leave me alone old man” Lucas spat with as much force as he could muster, grant it he thought, it didn’t sound like much to him, but the man nodded and continued on.



Lucas gently laid the bedsheets upon the mattress sitting down next to them to stare at the bland grey wall he followed the contours of the concrete, faded within the drab grey paint, he could see scratches and etchings, discolorations that looked as if the wall had been once written on, he imagined the people who sat in this cell prior and hoped they made it out, made it to a better life, because acknowledging the alternative was unthinkable for his sanity, he didn’t know what to expect or what to do and he finaly allowed himself to feel the fear that had been growing in his belly for the last few days. He felt an odd comfort running his fingers over the rough wool of the green blanket as he sat, in his thoughts thinking about the future and what it held for him. But the fear persisted, and it would not go away, he had to concentrate to not let it consume him.



Thirty minutes later the klaxon sounded, and the cage door opened announcing breakfast. Lucas made his was to the door and tentitavely stepped out onto the cold metal landing, looking out over the area, he had not noticed when he came but now that it was lighted, he could see what was hidden the night before in that the room itself was cavernous, spidered with grey metal scaffolding, measuring four stores, on each landing were cells as far as the eye could see going both ways, all the doors open and people stepping out of them, Lucas studied some of them , the hard looks on there faces, the tattoos adourning there bodies, they walked like predators, there eyes facing out, looking for the next prey or the next predator bigger then itself. Animals Lucas thought, they reminded him of animals, and the fear came back, would this be what he would become, nothing but an animal in this metal jungle. He tried to shake it off, but the thought persisted just under the surface of his conscious mind. A scuffle began on the tier across the canyon of contrete and metal , Lucas watchd with interest as two of the inmates began to beat each other, they were screaming but it was too far to make out the words, just when he thought they might kill one another , six silver saucer shapes quickly descended from the ceiling, two of them taking up close proximity to the fighters, the larger of the two , his tattoos covered most of his body and face, he looked almost native American, suddenly stopped as the saucer closest to him shot some type of round , which hit him square in the back, at about the same time the other saucer did the same to the scrawny white inmate with the mohawk, both men collapsed instantly and the saucers took up a position to watch the entire tier from above. No one else seemed to move to help the two inmates. “They see everything, they know everything” came a whisper to Lucas’s right, he looked to see a young thin brown boy no older then himself, with sunken eyes and a bad acne problem “what?” Lucas asked, thinking he didn’t hear him correctly.



The boy fidgeted with his hands and then slowly raising them to point, Lucas followed the motion and saw the camera set in to the upper corner of the wall “they see and hear, everything” the boy whispered again and then turned his blank stare back to the bodies laying across the cavern. Lucas looked around the room and noticed hundreds of cameras, turning he saw the two in his cell as well, the boy was right, there was no privacy here, he would have to be mindful of that. Another klaxon sounded and the group on his tier turned right, he slowly mimicked the gesture and followed the shuffling line alone the metal scaffolding. The line walked along the hallway for what seemed like a mile Lucas began counting cameras to distract himself, one every twenty feet he thought, pointing at various angles to minimize blind spots his thoughts were iunterupted as the group in front of him turned into a corridor, looking down through the metal grate he could see the group below doing the same, in fact across the entire large bay they all turned in towards there perspective walls to enter the corridor. Lucas entered the hallway when it was his turn, the distance to what appeared to be a larger room no more then ten feet and just like that , he entered the large room filled with metal tables and benches, in fact it looked a lot like the cafeteria in school, complete with a food bar along one wall, staffed with what looked like inmates serving food , the line bended left entering into a set of metal bars sending the group along the food line.



Following the line, he grabbed a stainless-steel tray and offered it up at each of the stations, the food looked drab and colorless, in fact most of items looked like various types of gruel. At the end, he exited the line and looked around the room for a place to sit. Spying the room a large bald man with a cross tattooed on his forehead smiled at him and patted the seat next to him, motioning for Lucas to take it, just as he was about to move towards it he heard an urgent whisper from behind him “never sit with him, not there, whatever you do” came the voice of the young man who resided in the next cell to him. Lucas decided to take his advice and found an empty table, taking a seat, the young boy sat across from him. Lucas could see his eyes furtively looking around as he began to quickly eat his food. “Why did you warn me?” Lucas whispered to him eyeing the room to see who was watching, the kid’s paranoia rubbing off on him.



“Never sit with Grigor, never be alone with Grigor… he is bad, does bad things” the kid spat in between bites of runny food. Lucas thought on this, the kid seemed scared of the big guy and that was something worth listening to. “What is your name?” he asked gently. The young man seemed to think on it for a moment “Miguel, Miguel Ramirez, but everyone calls me mouse” he whispered, almost to the point where Lucas couldn’t hear it. Nodding he eyed Grigor’s table and could see the big man glaring at him and then at mouse.



In the back of his mind he could sense the danger that gaze promised and shivered. He could tell this was not a man he wanted to trifle with, and the peril of his situation hit home as he realized, this person could kill him. Looking at the few guards in the room he broke out in a cold sweat, there were no teachers or people to run to , no one to settle the situation for him, he was on his own for the first time in his life, then he remembered his fathers cold dead body hitting the glass and his eyes began to well up crying is weakness said a hard voice in his head and he blinked them back, he would not let this man see him weak, he couldn’t somewhere in his mind he knew that would seal his fate.



He turned his attention back to mouse “How long have you been here man?” he asked gently, the look of this poor waif said he had been treated badly and his eyes told him he would bolt at the first sign of a loud noise, Lucas desperately needed interatction, contact anything that could take his mind off of his surroundings. Mouse looked around the room again, his gaze not falling on the guards but on Grigor and he seemed to shrink further down into his seat, he could sense the danger too Lucas thought. “two years” he said softly, and Lucas again felt fear, was this how he would look after two years here, would he be this beaten and broken waif of a boy? he thought again eyeing Grigor’s table, but Grigor had gone back to eating and talking amonst the other men at his table. As he spoke another one, one with cold green eyes kept looking over towards him and smiling, that smile set a rock in the bottom of his stomach, that smile spoke of pain later. He tried to look away but found he couldn’t, he watched in horror as cold eyes blew him a kiss and went back to talking with Grigor. For the first time, Lucas realized there were worse things here then getting beaten up the chilling cold of fear biting harder now.



Breakfast ended twenty minutes later and the convicts entered the line back to their cells, Lucas could feel Grigor and cold eyes drilling holes in the back of his head, he didn’t dare look back, instead focused on the cameras and drones that seemed to be present everything, he hoped anyway for as long as he was watched, then he would be safe, he thought. “What are we doing now” Lucas whispered to mouse as he walked directly in front of him.



“Back to cell, clean and count three hours, then we will be out to the yard for one hour” he answered without turning and pitching his voice low, just above a whisper so that Lucas could hear. Mouse slowed a bit and then spoke “H-E-L-L-O 8-5-12-12-15” he finished and then repeated it, just as Lucas got to the door of his cell, what the hell he thought entering the small room as the door closed behind him. Sitting in the small cell he wished for a window, just to see the outside would have been a dream, it was amazing what you missed it was taken away. Lucas slumped on the bed feeling another way of drepression crash against his consciousness. He didn’t need to be here, he was innocent, he hadn’t done anything and yet here he was, He was angry and afraid, he beat his head against the wall on the other side of his bunk, the small amount of pain taking his mind off of his thoughts.



Once he stopped, he could hear a rhythmic tapping against the wall, he held his breath and listened, there it was again, he could hear a pattern. Then the pattern repeated itself, on the third time around he counted the taps, remembering what mouse had said to him eight taps, five taps, twelve taps, twelve taps and finally fifteen taps each set with a two second pause in between hello Lucas thought, understanding finally what mouse had meant.



Using his middle knuckle, he sent back the same message and waited, within a minute another set of taps came through this one much longer and took Lucas twice around to get it good, now we can talk it said
